items.title: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) Could Be 13% Undervalued On Mixed Third Quarter Earnings
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) just delivered third quarter earnings that showed basic earnings per share from continuing operations of US$1.26, slightly below the US$1.31 reported for the same period a year earlier. Recent action around PayPal Holdings reflects that mixed picture. The 7.8% one-month share price return and 3.9% seven-day gain suggest that momentum has picked up into and after the earnings release, even though the one-year total shareholder return is still down 9.6% and the five-year...

items.title: American Express vs. PayPal: Which Stock Does Wall Street Expect to Grow Faster Through 2027?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAnalysts expect American Express’s normalized EPS to rise 31% from 2025 to 2027, against 11% for PayPal. American Express’s higher forward P/E is backed by that faster growth, which makes it the better buy of the two today.
